description: Query a directory API with its key. Pass filters as params (see the API's query parameters from search_apis). Returns data plus provenance, coverage and quality warnings. A call returns up to 50 records; for more, set limit to up to 500 (10x the call price) or up to 3,000 (60x), paid from the key's credit; you pay only for records returned (see options from search_apis or get_plans; fast-changing feeds also offer live=true: data re-read just before answering, 5x the call price).
name: query_api
title: Query an API
